**IdeaBlade Validation Editor 0.1.1**: a fix to 0.1.0 for the rule cards' layout.

## Downloads

| | Download | Installing |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.1.exe](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-Setup-0.1.1.exe) | Run it. It's not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn: *More info* → *Run anyway*. It installs for everyone (Program Files, with an administrator prompt) or only for you, over an earlier version if that's installed. |
| **macOS**, Apple silicon | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-mac-arm64.dmg) | Open it and drag the app to Applications. It's not signed with an Apple certificate or notarized, so the first time, right-click the app → *Open* → *Open* (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine "/Applications/IdeaBlade Validation Editor.app"`). |
| **macOS**, Intel | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-mac-x64.dmg) | As for Apple silicon. |
| **Linux** (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage) | `chmod +x` it and run it. |
| **Linux**, Debian or Ubuntu (x64) | [IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/download/v0.1.1/IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb) | `sudo apt install ./IdeaBlade-Validation-Editor-0.1.1-linux-amd64.deb` |

**Updating:** 0.1.0, alpha.3 and alpha.4 on Windows or as an AppImage find this version by themselves (at start, every few hours, or Help → Check for Updates…), download it, and offer **Restart to update**. On macOS and with the .deb they say it's out and link here. Coming from alpha.1 or alpha.2, install it by hand once.

## What's changed since 0.1.0

- **A closed rule card's head stays on one line.** With a long id, a condition and a longer expression, the head wrapped: the summary or the ↑ ↓ ✕ buttons went to a second line, so the cards were uneven. Now the summary takes the room that's left and ends in "…", a long id shortens too (both show in full on hover), and the buttons stay at the right end.
- A test that could fail by chance on macOS, depending on which test ran first, no longer does. It held up the 0.1.0 release run, not the app.

See the [README](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/blob/v0.1.1/README.md) for the details, [0.1.0's notes](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation-editor/releases/tag/v0.1.0) for what's in the editor, and the [library's documentation](https://github.com/Breeze/ideablade-validation/tree/main/docs) for the metadata itself.
